interest: Cuban spy scares over Yukihi George Ozawa and Japanese boats near Cochinos Bay.
overview: Docket for 894.20237 (1932–39) on Japanese activity in Cuba, chiefly the case of Yukihi George Ozawa, jailed for practicing medicine rather than spying.
